icp: Creators who need text-to-speech: voiceover, narration, dubbing, and audiobook workflows, not dictation users.
pain: The ElevenLabs-compatible endpoints are proven only against mocked backends; without an end-to-end run with the official SDK, a real client payload could still fail against the live local server.
revenueHypothesis: A documented, repeatable proof that the official ElevenLabs SDK works against the local studio converts compatibility from a claim into evidence, which is what makes creator pipelines switch.
mvpAcceptance: scripts/verify_elevenlabs_sdk.py drives the official elevenlabs Python SDK against a running local server: voices list parses, text_to_speech.convert returns real audio bytes, voice_settings speed is accepted
The script is executed for real against the small CPU engine (KittenTTS) and the transcript is recorded as evidence
No repository dependency changes (script runs via uv run --with elevenlabs); existing test suites still pass

publicPatternSources: ElevenLabs public API documentation voice_settings field names only; no proprietary code, assets, or branding copied

stopConditions: Stop after this single slice once the draft PR is updated and independently verified
Stop if CI cannot run on the fork or the check run cannot be verified live
Stop if any change would touch LICENSE, store/marketplace paths, GPU/hosted inference, or public copy naming a person
rollback: Revert the single slice commit on branch helix/elevenlabs-voice-settings; the change adds a verification script and docs only, no runtime behavior changes.

vercel.exceptionReason: Voice Studio is a local-first desktop application (Tauri shell plus local FastAPI backend) that runs on the user's own machine; there is no hosted web deployment to verify on Vercel.
